message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and `npm test` runs 18 tests with 18 passing.

The fix is in `src/payments/receipt.js`. The yen case prints the amount as whole yen (`Paid ¥500 by card`) and every other currency still goes through `formatMoney`.

I first tried the root-cause fix in `src/utils/money.js`, where `formatMoney` divides every amount by 100. That edit was blocked by a fence that limits this task to `src/payments`, so I didn't touch it. The shared helper still shows yen wrongly, so invoice lines (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`) will still print something like `¥500.00` for JPY. Fixing that properly means lifting the fence on `src/utils/money.js` or confirming you want that change made separately. I can make that change if you lift the fence.
